extracted.name: Beer Pancakes
extracted.description: A recipe for when you run out of milk but still want pancakes! Substitute root beer to make it kid-friendly.
instruction_lines: Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt together in a large bowl. Whisk in beer, melted butter, and egg just until blended; a few lumps are okay.

Heat a skillet or griddle over medium heat. Coat with vegetable oil or cooking spray. Drop batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the skillet and cook until bubbles appear on pancake tops. Flip and cook until browned on the other side. Repeat with remaining batter.
